name: How We Play
tagline: Helping your team take the next step.
philosophy: Simple pictures. Simple decisions. Play together.
description: Free football formation guides, tactical diagrams and practical advice for grassroots coaches. Understand how your team plays, explain the decisions that matter and help young players work together.
independence: How We Play is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by The FA or England Football.
proposition: From the early small-sided formats to the challenges of moving up, How We Play is about making football easier to understand and easier to teach.

author.name: Niall Walsh
author.role: Grassroots football coach and founder of How We Play
author.short: Volunteer grassroots football coach for seven years
